title: Multi-site electrocatalysts for hydrogen production under neutral conditions
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00881F, Review Article
Zhouzhou Wang, Jianqing Zhou, Yaran Shi, Li Luo, Haoran Li, Qiancheng Zhou, Chunchun Wang, Zhuo Xing, Ze Yang, Ying Yu
This article reviews the fundamental understandings, design strategies, synthesis methods, characterization analyses, and electrolyzer applications of multi-site electrocatalysts to promote hydrogen production under neutral conditions.
